data.name: Shadown
data.detailed_description:
In a world of complex geometry, walls are no longer obstacles. Master your only gate—Shadows—and rewrite the logic of space.

About This Game

Shadown is a minimalist third-person environmental puzzle game. Set in a dreamlike world inspired by Liminal Spaces and Core-style aesthetics, you play as an explorer gifted with the unique ability to "pass through shadows."

Conventional physics do not apply here. You must not only find the path but create it. By manipulating objects to cast specific shadows, you will turn solid walls into gateways, flat ground into abysses, and silhouettes into corridors to reach your destination.

Core Mechanics

  • Dimensional Penetration: Shadows on walls act as one-way doors; shadows on the floor become "skylights" you can drop through.

  • Shadow Transition: Step into paired orange and blue projections to instantly teleport across the map.

  • Optical Reconstruction: Slide geometric blocks along tracks to realign light and shadow, solving intricate logical puzzles in real-time.

Key Features

  • Immerse yourself in a serene, profound, and dream-like visual experience built with pure geometric forms.

  • Break free from traditional maze-solving. Learn to perceive and manipulate space through the lens of light and shadow.

  • Deeply customize your character’s appearance to make your journey through the void unique.

  • Use the powerful Built-in Level Editor to challenge the community’s creativity or share your own ultimate architectural puzzles.

data.short_description: A minimalist puzzle-platformer where the core mechanic revolves around 'walking through shadows.' By manipulating environmental triggers and contraptions, you guide your character to the goal to clear each level.
data.supported_languages: English, French, German, Russian, Japanese, Simplified Chinese

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-2100 / AMD FX-6300
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon HD 7770 / Intel UHD Graphics 630
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600 or higher
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: VIDIA GeForce GTX 1050 Ti / AMD Radeon RX 570 or higher
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
